quote: The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it.
Export succeeds | "Success", "Data exported successfully." | Success toast, as on the other reports
Export with no rows | "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" | Warning toast; nothing downloads
Export fails for any other reason | "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." | Error toast; nothing downloads; these six reports only
Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button

The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.
Filters leave no rows | "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." | Native empty state with "Clear all filters"

Drill-down keeps the report's scope. Clicking a customer or vendor on a Summary opens Collection or Unpaid Invoices with the same as-of date and the same chosen locations. Basis: d-drill-in-inherits-scope.

The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.

Click an invoice at another enrolled location | Title "Switch location?", message "This work order is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Dialog on the report; "Switch location" switches and opens, "Cancel" stays
Click a part sale at another enrolled location | "This part sale is in {location}. Switch your active location to view it?" | Same dialog
Report fails to load | "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." | In place of the rows, plus the standard error toast

On A/R Collection, every CSV row also carries the customer's "Phone" and, for users with 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Credit term", in columns right after "Customer"; the PDF prints them on each customer's line (Story 9).
A user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' sees no credit term on screen, none in the PDF, and no Credit term column in the CSV.
PDF export over 2,000 rows | "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads

Other improvements found in research, each a separate ticket on SV-11315: a credit dated on the as-of date landing in 1-30 instead of Current (SV-11441, checked against QuickBooks first); configurable aging periods (SV-11442); send a statement from the report (SV-11443); salesperson and Parts vs Service filters (SV-11444); last payment date and credit limit (SV-11446); a collections notes log (SV-11447).
